scientific_integrity: The theorem is supported by exact characteristic-independent incidence arithmetic and an exhaustive finite marking census. The two finite-field checks are independent cross-checks; neither is treated as infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: For the standard Fermat cubic in characteristic unequal to 3; an equivalent Weyl-group table or inaccessible full text could affect historical priority; independent mathematical audit has not been performed.
title: Frobenius descent of sixers and double-sixes on the Fermat cubic surface
